constraints: they can be blocked by post-transition metals, particularly lead

evidence.locator: Their hunting methods consist of emitting a single burst of a previously unknown type of wave (dubbed ██████ waves, in honor of the late Doctor ██████), which permanently inhibits the ability of the affected creature to enter any of the NREM and REM sleep stages.

effects.trigger: After depriving their victims of sleep

evidence.locator: After depriving their victims of sleep, SCP-966 will stalk their prey until the lack of rest incapacitates it.

effects.trigger: SCP-966 are visible only at wavelengths ranging from 700 nm to about 900 nm
constraints: SCP-966 are visible only at wavelengths ranging from 700 nm to about 900 nm

evidence.locator: Two security cameras with infrared filters and infrared-sensitive film are to be installed inside the room.
